properties.name: branch overlay
properties.purpose: Holds a branch's implementation facts (build-measured records and branch-dependent status, per dec:which-design-records-belong-to-a-branch) in a per-(design, branch) overlay over the one shared store, until the branch's code reaches main. Reads for a session on that branch see shared ∪ overlay. Exports for that worktree write shared ∪ overlay. The overlay folds into shared when main's committed design carries its facts, and it is retired unmerged when the branch is deleted. Persisted beside the store. Designed 2026-09-23 (dec:how-a-branchs-implementation-facts-are-held); planned.
